consumer side: libcgi.so.1.0 do_auth@0x85a14 (imported by httpd) calls handle_auth@plt and handle_auth_onlyMAC@plt; busybox login + /usr/sbin/telnetd (S20-startipcam, Telnetd.Enabled) reference /etc/passwd - MAC-derived and hardcoded root credentials are remotely usable
no patch indicators: no length/entropy checks, no random source, fallback constant "ipcam_reserve_password"@0x77f30 for crypt failure
verdicts.reason: generate_pass_from_mac (impl libnvram.so.1.0:0x59d64, called unconditionally from /bin/httpd main init at 0xa770 when PnP provider is not Qlync) rewrites /etc/passwd at every boot with (1) a compile-time hardcoded root hash abATsxpNxEp4Y and (2) a second UID-0 account whose username and password are derived solely from the last 4 MAC bytes via deterministic double DES crypt with fixed salts AM/ab - zero/<=32-bit entropy exactly as CVE-2025-6931 (CWE-330) describes; firmware v2.02.01 is within vuldb's 'below or equal v2.02.01' range (PoC report targets this exact build), so version gate passes.
